name: CERT Polska Hole (warning list of dangerous domains)
operator: CERT Polska (NASK - Naukowa i Akademicka Siec Komputerowa)
tier_rationale: National CERT of Poland (A8 trusted: national CERTs/CSIRTs); P071 chair: 'CERT.PL and Procon-SP are trusted'.

reliability.justification: Entries are vetted by CERT Polska analysts before they enter the warning list; listings are dated (InsertDate) and removals are recorded.

hole_domains.title: CERT.PL warning list domains (v2 CSV: domain, InsertDate, DeleteDate)

terms.quote: Per-feed terms: CERT.PL Hole (any use incl. commercial; trusted), Phishing.Database (MIT), StevenBlack (MIT), MetaMask eth-phishing-detect (permissive), spmedia (MIT), Botvrij, CyberCrime-Tracker and Procon-SP run with attribution. HaGeZi TIF and ScamSniffer are GPL-3.0 data: runtime download only, never bundled or used as fixtures (A6).

hole_domains.notes: Quote: binding council text (P071 cond 2). https://hole.cert.pl/domains/v2/domains.csv (tab-separated, ~7 MB; the JSON variant holds the same fields at ~22.7 MB, the TXT variant has no dates) fetched by `v3lum data update` only (> 5 MB, A6) and indexed locally (disclosure 'none'). InsertDate gives the listing date; removals come from snapshot diffs (DeleteDate was null in every sampled record, 2026-11-26).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G03-1 (P071 url_domain_blocklists). Downloaded and matched locally: no investigated value is ever sent to CERT Polska.
